issue_request: FHIR-16095 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to rename the old MedicationKnowledge.cost.formulary attribute to source and make it 0..1, change the medicine classification value to CodeableConcept, rename the old medication-name element to synonym with description, and remove the old description data element.
initial_application: GF-16095-tagged source history shows the request was applied during MedicationKnowledge development. Commit 3fb9137568b7dc812a358c405f25cedc82ba3024 changed the old spreadsheet from cost.formulary 1..1 to cost.source 0..1, changed medicineClassification.classification from string to CodeableConcept, renamed MedicationKnowledge.name to MedicationKnowledge.synonym with explanatory text, and removed MedicationKnowledge.description. Later GF-16095 commits c78bc226e5ca077b65f8c7a49d31272801ec620d and ff9266d082ef6dd553a653a50eb5d4a6426b73ba further reworked MedicationKnowledge while preserving the surviving requested semantics.
additional_context: MedicationKnowledge is active in source/fhir.ini. Current combined-branch source retains MedicationKnowledge.cost.source as 0..1 and MedicationKnowledge.medicineClassification.classification as CodeableConcept, while the old cost.formulary, synonym, and description data elements are absent. Later final decisions FHIR-32801 and FHIR-45285 made MedicationKnowledge a MetadataResource/CanonicalResource-compatible artifact, so the current MedicationKnowledge.name is intentionally a 0..1 computer-friendly metadata name, not the old medication synonym element. A checked-in SVG still has stale medication-name tooltip text, but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact rather than the authoritative source.
reconciliation: Created an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk was necessary because the current source already satisfies the surviving FHIR-16095 changes and the apparent name/synonym discrepancy is superseded by later final metadata decisions.
